maria_cs: FYI — AcmeCorp flagged a month-close mismatch. Their invoice shows 1,203,412 tokens but the dashboard export shows 947,218. They asked during reconciliation and raised INC-34567. Screenshot posted.
jamal_support: Assigned. Can you paste account_id + invoice id? Also which dashboard view / timezone was used?
maria_cs: account: acct_0A1B2C, invoice: inv_20260228_001. Dashboard view: Billing > Usage (UTC). Customer originally did some manual CSV exports in PST and saw ~947k.
devon_billing: Pulling the invoice lines now. Invoice agg cutoff is 00:00 UTC by design. Dashboard should match but could be stale or ingestion gap. Running diff query.
devon_billing: ```sql
-- usage by day for acct_0A1B2C (UTC)
select date_trunc('day', timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') as day, sum(tokens) as tokens
from usage_events
where account_id='acct_0A1B2C' and timestamp >= '2026-02-01' and timestamp < '2026-03-01'
group by 1
order by 1;
```
anika_engineer: Heads up — last night's billing-aggregator had a retry loop for one partition around 02:42 UTC. Worker restarted after a KV timeout. It retried events via the retry path. I want to check idempotency for that codepath.
jamal_support: If invoice > dashboard, likely either invoice picked up late events that dashboard didn't, or invoice double-counted. Devon can you list invoice line breakdown (gen vs embed vs plan)?
devon_billing: Invoice lines show: - gen-tokens: 1,021,034 - embed-tokens: 182,378 - plan base: 0. Total tokens = 1,203,412. Dashboard raw export (pre-backfill) showed gen 798,200 / embed 149,018 = 947,218. Delta = 256,194 (mostly gen). Running delta by event_id for Feb 28 00:00-03:00 UTC.
anika_engineer: Quick join shows ~256k tokens coming from events with source='async-batch' where ingestion_ack was never set because the retry path writes billing rows before updating the MV flag. Dashboard queries filter ingestion_ack=true, so those events were excluded. Invoice was generated from billing-rows table which did include them. Bug found.
laura_csm: Customer wants timeline and an ETA for fix and backfill. They also asked for a provisional credit until clarified. They paused payments for the disputed invoice.
devon_billing: Proposed remediation: issue provisional credit for the delta (~256,194 tokens, est $1,024) and run a backfill of the dashboard MV for acct_0A1B2C for Feb 28. If backfill confirms usage, we notify and revoke credit with 7-day notice. Sound ok?
jamal_support: :thumbsup: I'll draft the message. Anika — ETA for patch + backfill?
anika_engineer: Patch to mark ingestion_ack in retry path is small; deploying now. ETA ~4 hours for deploy + verification. Backfill (one-off recompute for that account/day) ~30 minutes. I'll coordinate infra window.
devops-bot: deploy-bot: Started deploy redwood/billing-aggregator@v1.3.7 to prod (anika_engineer).
devops-bot: deploy-bot: Deploy succeeded (billing-aggregator v1.3.7) — 02:05 UTC.
anika_engineer: Patch deployed. Backfill queued and running now against materialized view for acct_0A1B2C 2026-02-28 UTC. Monitoring job logs.
anika_engineer: Backfill finished. Dashboard now reports gen 1,021,034 / embed 182,378 = 1,203,412 tokens, matching the invoice. Root cause: retry path didn't set ingestion_ack; billing table and invoice generation used billing_rows which were written, causing discrepancy. PR: #4921 (fix + unit test). Also ran a quick search — found 8 other accounts with similar pattern; filing follow-ups.
laura_csm: Thanks — I'll send the customer a formal note: root cause, actions taken (patch + backfill), provisional credit, and next steps.
maria_cs: Acme accepted the explanation and asked for a credit note. Ticket INC-34567 updated -> pending-credit. Closing the loop.
notes: investigation, patch, backfill, provisional credit, ticket updated
